answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 8058 Country: United Kingdom Title: A company intends to prepare feed for cows and chickens by using feathers, blood and dead chickens (before they are slaughtered Islamicaly).2- Would it be allowed to provide this feed? 3- Would it be allowed to supply and feed the cows and chickens with this feed? 4-Would it be allowed to sell this feed? Question: 1--A company intends to prepare feed for cows and chickens by using feathers, blood and dead chickens (before they are slaughtered Islamicaly).2- Would it be allowed to provide this feed? 3- Would it be allowed to supply and feed the cows and chickens with this feed? 4-Would it be allowed to sell this feed? Answer ID: 8058 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2085/1593=B=1429) It is neither lawful to eat carrion and unlawful and impure things, nor to feed them to animals and nor to supply them. Also, it is unlawful to do business of such things. However, if the animal food is prepared by adding lawful and pure things in a large quantity, and the nature of those things is changed through chemicals, then it will be allowable to prepare such animal food as well as to sell it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
